display.purpose: The name of the product, once, at the top of the page.

native.purpose: The Malayalam in the compose field and in the candidates.

label.purpose: The state of the model, the captions and the table headers. Never uppercase.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The keyboard panel, the one object that floats above the page.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: A key that is pressed. A step lighter and a lift of one pixel.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Chips, candidates and links changing state.

motion.name: ready
motion.purpose: The space bar taking the accent when there is a candidate.

motion.name: commit
motion.purpose: The panel taking the accent border when a word is committed.

components.name: Letter Key
components.description: A letter of the keyboard. No border, one step above the keyboard body.
components.css: .ds-key { background: #31353b; color: #e8eaed; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; height: 44px; min-width: 44px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 90ms ease, transform 90ms ease; } .ds-key:hover { background: #383d44; } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Function Key
components.description: A key that does something other than type a letter. The shift, the backspace and the numbers.
components.css: .ds-key-function { background: #3a3f46; color: #c9ced5; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-key-function svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Enter Key
components.description: The one key that commits a line. It carries the accent.

components.name: Candidate
components.description: A word the keyboard offers. The first one is the one the space bar takes.
components.css: .ds-candidate { background: #3a3f46; color: #e8eaed; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: "Noto Sans Malayalam", "Nirmala UI", Kartika, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease; } .ds-candidate:hover { background: #454b53; } .ds-candidate-first { background: #2c5f8a; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 18px; padding: 6px 18px; } .ds-candidate-first:hover { background: #35709f; }

components.name: Compose Field
components.description: Where the word is written. The Malayalam lands here.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 14px; background: #23262b; border: 1px solid #24272c; border-radius: 14px; color: #e8eaed; font-family: "Noto Sans Malayalam", "Nirmala UI", Kartika, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 21px; line-height: 1.45; resize: none; caret-color: #7fb0de; } .ds-field:focus { outline: 2px solid #7fb0de; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Example Chip
components.description: A word that fills the field when it is tapped.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #31353b; color: #a2a9b2; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #3a3f46; color: #e8eaed; }

components.name: Keyboard Panel
components.description: The strip and the keys. The one object on the page that floats.
components.css: .ds-keyboard { background: #1b1d21; border-radius: 20px; padding: 0 8px 10px; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85); } .ds-strip { display: flex; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 8px 6px; background: #23262b; border-bottom: 1px solid #3a3f46; border-radius: 19px 19px 0 0; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-keys { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding-top: 6px; }

components.name: Results Table
components.description: The measured results. No frame, a hairline under the header, none under the last row.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-table th { text-align: left; padding: 0 0 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2b2f35; color: #8b939d; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-table td { padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #24272c; color: #a2a9b2; } .ds-table td.num { width: 84px; text-align: right; color: #e8eaed; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: MangoKeys is one product in two places: an Android input method and a web demo. They share a model, a word list and a ranking, and they share a face. The world is settled and it is the world's of the app: a near-black ground, four steps of cool neutral lifted by small lightness changes rather than by borders, one accent that does real work, and a density that matches a phone. Nothing is decorated. The voice is plain and technical, the way the report is written.
keyCharacteristics: One ground, four lifts, one accent.
The accent is a verb: it marks the action the space bar will take.
Every number on the page is read from a file that an evaluation wrote.
The Malayalam is the largest type on the page.
Drawn icons, one stroke weight, never a glyph standing in for a symbol.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on at most three things at once: the first candidate, the enter key and the state of the switch. Its rarity is what makes it mean this one.

rules.name: The Lightness Ladder Rule
rules.body: A panel is separated from what is behind it by lightness, not by a border.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor
rules.body: Body text and placeholders sit at 4.5:1 or better against the surface they are on.

rules.name: The Native Rule
rules.body: The Malayalam is always set in the Malayalam face and never in the interface face.

rules.name: The Plain Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at their own size. There are no small caps, no tracked caps and no kickers.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the object floats. Only the keyboard floats.

dos: Do keep the candidate strip, the keyboard and the compose field in that order, with the strip directly above the keys.
Do let the accent mark the first candidate and the enter key, and nothing else on the screen at the same time.
Do read every number from a file that an evaluation wrote, and say so in the page when the number has a limit.
Do set the Malayalam in the Malayalam face, at the largest size it is given on the page.
donts: Don't add a second accent, a gradient, a glow or a glass effect. The ground is the product.
Don't put the strip's candidates in the key colour. They would read as keys and the signature would be lost.
Don't use a glyph font for the shift, the backspace or the enter.
Don't uppercase the labels, and don't put a small tracked label above a heading.
Don't claim anything the repository does not measure, including the coverage of the word list.
